ownership.parent: A1 Digital International GmbH & Co KG (part of A1 Telekom Austria Group, majority-owned by América Móvil; listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange)
ownership.quote: Exoscale is a trademark of Akenes SA, a private company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Switzerland. ... Exoscale is a member of A1 Digital International GmbH & Co KG, which was launched in 2017 ... A1 Digital is part of A1 Telekom Austria Group, a leading provider of digital services and communications solutions in Central and Eastern Europe with more than 24 million customers. The Group is listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange.

stage.quote: Exoscale is a member of A1 Digital International GmbH & Co KG ... A1 Digital is part of A1 Telekom Austria Group ... The Group is listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange.
stage.note: Exoscale/Akenes SA was founded as an independent Swiss company in 2011 and later became a member of A1 Digital (A1 Telekom Austria Group); no independent funding rounds for Exoscale itself were found, so classic VC funding-stage fields do not apply.

note: Exoscale is the Swiss/European cloud platform trademark of Akenes SA (founded 2011), which is a member of A1 Digital International GmbH & Co KG, itself part of the publicly traded A1 Telekom Austria Group (majority owner: América Móvil, 58%). No separate VC funding rounds, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue figures for Exoscale/Akenes SA were found; financial figures cited (A1 Telekom Austria Group revenue) are for the whole parent group, not Exoscale specifically.
